commitMessage:
Fix consent status for read-only accounts; Sync permissions also repairs reseller device access

- Users and Consents pages showed 'Versi lama' for read-only customers who
  had agreed to the current version: such accounts can only store
  termsAccepted on the server (the version stays in their browser), so the
  read-only check now runs before the old-version check and also counts
  the server-wide read-only setting.
- 'Samakan Hak Akses' now applies the role presets and then completes the
  reseller -> customer device links (same as 'Perbaiki Akses Perangkat'),
  reports both counts, and warns about customers marked read-only.
- Docs updated.
